body:
Our Nixodine range brings together eleven brands and 162 products, from compact devices to very large ones, and from fruit-focused lineups to varied catalogs. This is a neutral guide to comparing them: what to look at, what our catalog lists for each brand, how prices and capacities compare, how to try brands without wasting money and how to ask us for help. It does not rank brands or make quality or health claims. It is written for adults aged 21 and over. We make no health claims about Nixodine or any product, and regulatory treatment of newer ingredients can change, so always check the label and your local rules.

## Brands you will find
By number of listings in our Nixodine category, they are:
- **NIX Liquids:** 28 products.
- **Geek Labs:** 23 products.
- **Rinnbar:** 20 products.
- **Rifbar:** 15 products.
- **Lost Mary:** 15 products.
- **Hotbox:** 14 products.
- **Hookah Labs:** 11 products.
- **YOVO:** 10 products.
- **Juice Head:** 9 products.
- **Parfflo:** 8 products.
- **Fifty Bar:** 9 products.

Counts change as stock changes, so check the [Nixodine page](/shop/nixodine/) for the current range.

## How they differ
- **Puff count and size:** from compact devices at about 20,000 puffs to very large ones at 80,000.
- **Flavor lineups:** some focus on fruit and ice, others include candy, dessert and beverage flavors.
- **Price:** our listings range from about $14.99 to $19.99 for most devices.
- **Features:** screens, boost modes, airflow controls and battery sizes vary.
- **Product format:** most are disposables, with some 100 mL bottles from certain brands.

## What the catalog shows by brand
### Hookah Labs
Large-capacity devices, with the 80,000-puff size listed at about $17.99. Flavors include fruit, ice and candy styles.

### Geek Labs and Geek Bar-style lines
A large range of devices in the 50,000-puff class and others, with a wide flavor selection.

### Rinnbar and Rifbar
Large lineups of 50,000-puff devices in many flavors. See the guides for [Rifbar](/blog/rifbar-vape-brand-guide/) and [Rinnbar](/blog/rinnbar-vape-brand-guide/).

### Lost Mary
Devices with listed capacities such as 35,000 puffs, in a broad flavor range. See [Lost Mary](/blog/lost-mary-vape-brand-guide/).

### Hotbox, YOVO, Parfflo and Fifty Bar
Mid-sized lineups with a range of flavors and capacities. Check each listing.

### NIX Liquids and Juice Head
These brands include 100 mL bottles for refillable devices, as well as devices in some listings. Check the product format on each page.

## Brand guides
Read the guides for [Lost Mary](/blog/lost-mary-vape-brand-guide/), [Rifbar](/blog/rifbar-vape-brand-guide/), [Hookah Labs](/blog/hookah-labs-vape-brand-guide/) and [Geek Labs](/blog/geek-labs-vape-brand-guide/). They list the live product counts, price ranges and example products for each brand in our catalog.

## How to compare
Use [cost per puff](/blog/how-to-compare-vape-prices-per-puff/) and check each page for battery and flavor details. A simple method is to write down, for each candidate, the price, the puff count, the cost per 1,000 puffs, the battery and charging port and the flavor. Compare the numbers, then think about which flavors you would enjoy. A brand that offers your favorite flavor at good value usually wins.

### A worked comparison
Suppose Brand A lists a 50,000-puff device at $17.99, Brand B a 35,000-puff device at $16.99 and Brand C an 80,000-puff device at $17.99. Cost per 1,000 puffs is about $0.36 for A, $0.49 for B and $0.22 for C. If you will use the capacity, C is the best value, then A, then B. If you are trying a flavor for the first time, A or B may carry less commitment. These are example numbers drawn from typical listings, and you should check the live prices.

## Ask first
If you are unsure about a product's ingredient, ask us. We make no health claims about Nixodine or any product, and regulatory treatment of newer ingredients can change, so always check the label and your local rules. We will tell you what the manufacturer provides and what we do not know.

## Start small
Order one flavor first. See [how to choose a Nixodine device](/blog/how-to-choose-a-nixodine-device/). If you like it, consider a 5-pack bundle, where offered, and choose the option above the Add to Cart button. If you want to try several brands, buy single units of each rather than bundles.

## Things to look for on a brand's listings
- **Clear specifications,** including puff count and battery.
- **A strength label** as the manufacturer writes it.
- **A flavor description** or a recognizable flavor name.
- **A price** that fits the capacity.
- **Photos and packaging** that look consistent.

If listings are vague, ask us for more detail.

## Common mistakes
- **Choosing by brand name alone.**
- **Comparing devices of very different capacity without cost per puff.**
- **Buying bundles of untried flavors.**
- **Ignoring local rules.**
- **Forgetting storage and disposal.**

## Frequently asked questions in depth
### Which brand is best?
There is no single best brand. It depends on capacity, flavor, price and what you enjoy. Use the numbers and try one unit.

### Are bottles and devices interchangeable?
No. Bottles are for refillable devices, and disposables are sealed. Check the product format.

### Do brands release new flavors?
Often. Check the Nixodine page for current listings.

### Can I ask you for a recommendation?
Yes. Tell us your budget, capacity and flavor preferences, and we will point you to listings that match, without health claims.

## Shop
Browse [Nixodine products](/shop/nixodine/). All products are for adults aged 21 and over.

## A step-by-step way to compare brands
1. Pick your capacity range, for example 35,000 to 50,000 puffs.
2. List three or four brands with listings in that range.
3. For each, note the price, the puff count and the cost per 1,000 puffs.
4. Note the battery and charging port.
5. Choose two flavors from each that you would try.
6. Buy a single unit of your top choice from two brands.
7. Compare, and note what you prefer.

This simple process replaces guessing with a small experiment, and it costs less than buying a bundle of the wrong thing.

## What to ask a seller about a brand
Ask where the products come from, whether the brand provides documentation, what the return policy is and whether the product is allowed in your area. A seller that answers clearly is a better partner than one that is vague. We are happy to answer these questions about the listings we carry.

## Keeping up with the range
Brands add and remove products, and a listing you saw last month may have changed. Check the [Nixodine page](/shop/nixodine/) before you order. If a favorite disappears, ask us for similar listings. Remember that opened or used products cannot be returned, so choose carefully, and start small.

## Brand guides in the catalog
We have written brand guides for [Lost Mary](/blog/lost-mary-vape-brand-guide/), [Rifbar](/blog/rifbar-vape-brand-guide/), [Rinnbar](/blog/rinnbar-vape-brand-guide/), [Hookah Labs](/blog/hookah-labs-vape-brand-guide/), [Geek Labs](/blog/geek-labs-vape-brand-guide/), [Fifty Bar](/blog/fifty-bar-vape-brand-guide/) and others. They use live catalog data, so the counts and price ranges match what you see in the shop.

## A reminder on responsibility
Whichever brand you choose, the same rules apply. You must be 21 or older, an adult must sign on delivery, local laws apply and devices must be stored and disposed of responsibly. See [what 21+ age verification means](/blog/what-21-plus-age-verification-means/) and [how to dispose of vapes and batteries](/blog/how-to-dispose-of-vapes-and-batteries/).

## Frequently asked questions about brands
### Why are there so many brands?
The disposable market is crowded, and each brand tries to stand out with flavors, features and price. Our catalog reflects what is available.

### Do brands share factories?
We do not comment on how brands make products. We describe what is listed.

### Which brand has the most flavors?
The brands with the most listings, such as NIX Liquids, Geek Labs and Rinnbar, have the widest ranges in our catalog. Check the Nixodine page for the current range.

### Can I ask you which brand suits me?
Yes. Tell us your preferences, and we will suggest listings.

### How often does the range change?
Regularly. Check the page before you order.

## A short guide to using brand names wisely
A brand name is a starting point, not a verdict. It tells you who put their name on a product, which can help you find flavors and designs you like, but it does not tell you how a particular device will suit you. Judge each product on its listing, its price per puff and your own experience. If a brand has worked for you before, that is useful, and if not, you have lost little by trying a single unit.

## When to switch brands
If flavors from a brand repeatedly disappoint, if devices fail early, or if you simply want a change, try another brand with the same capacity and flavor family. Keep notes about what you liked, and you will build your own ranking, which is worth more than any list we could write.

### A closing reminder
Brands come and go, and ranges change. The habits that serve you well do not: compare cost per puff, read the label, check the rules, try one unit and keep notes. Use them with any brand, and you will choose well whatever the catalog looks like next month.

### Where to see the full range
The [Nixodine page](/shop/nixodine/) shows every brand and flavor we currently list, and each product page has the details you need to compare. If you cannot find something, ask us.
